section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section interprets the findings of the present study, which investigated whether body image flexibility mediated the associations between body size discrepancies and body appreciation in a pre-college sample of White older adolescent females. The results confirmed that compassionately and mindfully confronting body-related thoughts partially explains the inverse relationship between body dissatisfaction and body appreciation, even when controlling for BMI. The section also outlines several limitations of this single study, including its small, racially-homogenous, non-random, cross-sectional sample, low response rate, and reliance on self-report measures, while suggesting future research directions.
